scenario.name: r-cd-2-silent-wake
scenario.description: continue_delegate(mode='silent-wake') full path. The dispatch turn closes with an exact post-tool sentinel; the delegate return stays silent while triggering a fresh parent turn without channel output.

invocation.promptTemplate: Proof nonce {{nonce}}: reply with DONE and the nonce only. Do not mutate files. Do not post to any channel.

census.limits: The row’s topology receipt joins the typed tool span to the dispatch/fire spans by shared trace and chain identity. The census established that this is the only join available: the accepted entry span carries no origin, session, or turn identity, so the same-trace join cannot be reconstructed independently if the artifact is lost.

spans.name: continuation.finalization
spans.notes: The silent-wake claim ends at an observed wake lifecycle plus absence of channel delivery; there is no canonical terminal-outcome span to bind it to.

attributes.notes: Emitted today and already asserted by the row’s trace-correlation resolver. It is the strongest join currently available and it is not an identity.
silent-wake is already exported and is asserted by the row-scoped resolver.
no-channel-delivery is proven by absence today; a canonical outcome would make it a positive assertion.
Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: Reason material is published as a digest and a length only. The row-scoped authoritative receipt is signed and public-safe; raw reasons, prompts, session keys, run identifiers, and tokens never enter it.

controls.positive: The dispatch turn reaches its exact post-tool terminal sentinel inside its own run window, one topology-scoped typed continue_delegate completes, and a distinct same-session wake lifecycle is observed.
controls.negative: No channel message is delivered for the silent-wake return, generic delayed messages do not satisfy the lifecycle receipt, a trace carrying older unrelated activity does not satisfy the topology receipt, and replayInvalid is diagnostic unless the same bound lifecycle is actually incomplete.
controls.notes: The negative control is an absence proof. Without a canonical terminal outcome it cannot distinguish suppressed delivery from delivery that never happened.

backendUnavailable.notes: The row-scoped authoritative receipt is the verdict authority; a degraded Tempo makes the topology receipt unavailable and caps the row at PARTIAL-candidate rather than failing it.

artifact.notes: The authoritative receipt is digest-bound; a tampered receipt withholds the candidate envelope entirely.

verdictAuthority.pass: Only the validated row-scoped authoritative receipt can produce PASS-candidate, and only for the observed behavior. It is not a claim that the silent wake is re-identifiable from telemetry.
verdictAuthority.partial: Topology, wake lifecycle, or trace receipts are unavailable without a conclusive failed lifecycle, including when the telemetry backend is degraded or partial.
verdictAuthority.fail: A channel message is delivered for the silent-wake return, or the accepted dispatch lifecycle conclusively fails or does not reach its terminal sentinel. replayInvalid alone is not terminal authority after the same run proves typed dispatch, completion, wake, and quiet.

execution.deterministicK6: r-cd-2-silent-wake.js plus the row-scoped resolver produce the signed receipt; the runner withholds the envelope if the digest does not match.
execution.manual: Manual review inspects the Tempo projection for topology and redaction.
execution.relationship: The signed receipt outranks both the k6 summary verdict and manual review; manual review cannot promote a withheld envelope.

liveRunSafety.notes: Live continuation row. Fail closed when token/session env is missing, serialize per target session, and treat generated output as a PASS-candidate until required receipts are reviewed.

expectedReceipts.name: send-run-lifecycle
expectedReceipts.description: Accepted sessions.send run/turn ID is bound to lifecycle-start/end success, an exact sentinel observed only while that dispatch lifecycle is active, and a distinct same-session parent wake; generic delayed messages cannot satisfy it

expectedReceipts.name: task-ledger-entry
expectedReceipts.description: Optional extra context from the generic TaskFlow task ledger; continue_delegate does not reliably write here

expectedReceipts.name: child-session-key
expectedReceipts.description: Child session key from task metadata

expectedReceipts.name: typed-delegate-topology
expectedReceipts.description: One topology-scoped continue_delegate silent-wake tool execution plus continuation.delegate.dispatch/fire spans share one non-zero trace and chain, even when the trace carries older unrelated activity

expectedReceipts.name: tempo-trace-json
expectedReceipts.description: Public-safe Tempo trace projection that carries the same authoritative trace and chain binding as the accepted send lifecycle

expectedReceipts.name: no-channel-delivery
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate return does NOT produce a channel message (silent mode verified)

expectedReceipts.name: row-scoped-authoritative-receipt
expectedReceipts.description: Validated public-safe R-CD-2 receipt is the sole authority for candidate verdict surfaces

review.notes: Silent-wake path. Only the row-scoped authoritative receipt can produce PASS-candidate: the accepted dispatch turn must reach its explicit post-tool terminal boundary, one topology-scoped typed continue_delegate must complete, Tempo must prove same trace/chain dispatch+fire topology, the distinct wake lifecycle must be observed, and no channel delivery may occur.
